title: EngagementState
description: The per-customer engagement state persisted at engagements/<customer>/state/current.yaml. See design.md §Data Models — Model 5.

customer.description: Kebab-case customer identifier; matches the engagements/<customer>/ directory name.

intent.description: Intent tags captured from intake (e.g. ['gen-ai-rollout', 'responsible-ai']). At least one intent is required.

intake.description: Raw intake answers, preserved verbatim for auditing and replanning. Free-form per pipeline intake configuration.

aimTier.description: Current AIM tier estimate, 1..5. Optional until the assess stage closes.

decisions.description: Snapshot of the append-only decision log; the authoritative log lives at state/history.jsonl.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the engagement was initialized.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime of the most recent state-changing operation.

decision.description: A single entry in the append-only decision log.

ts.description: ISO 8601 datetime at which the decision was recorded.

actor.description: Origin of the decision: human FDE, the system (automated tool), or the planner.

kind.description: Stable kind tag for the decision (e.g. 'engagement-created', 'stage-advance', 'tier-updated').

detail.description: Structured payload describing the decision. Free-form per kind.
